sentences.en: Sami doesn't think that these things are correlated.
sentences.zh: 萨米认为这些事情之间没有关联。

sentences.en: I used to correlate love with sex.
sentences.zh: 我过去常把爱情和性联系在一起看待。

sentences.en: Some of the work in the workbook doesn't correlate with the readings in the textbook.
sentences.zh: 练习册中的一些作业与课本中的阅读内容不相关。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cor（共同）+relate（联系）→共同联系→相互关联影响
